name: GFT Technologies SE
summary: GFT Technologies SE, together with its subsidiaries, provides digital transformation services. The company operates in two segments, Americas, UK & APAC; and Continental Europe. It offers consulting on the development and realization of IT strategies, development of bespoke IT solutions, implementation of sector-specific software, and maintenance and development of business-critical IT solutions. The company also provides digital solutions. It serves retail banking, capital market, insurance, and Internet of Things sectors. The company operates in Brazil, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong, Italy, Canada, Mexico, Poland, Switzerland, Spain, the United States, and internationally. GFT Technologies SE was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany.
